source: Moving forward, I suggest skipping these nonsense leisure activities and using your spare time to contribute to the project, considering we’re in crunch time.
translation: 向前看，我建议跳过这些毫无意义的休闲活动，把空闲时间投入项目，毕竟我们正处于冲刺阶段。

source: It should be obvious that these routines are for health and wellness, not leisure. Which I’m sure you’ll agree is a requisite for labor-intensive jobs such as the ones Mr. Najjar and Mr. Sirius have.
translation: 很明显，这些日常安排是为了健康和身心状态，而不是休闲。我相信你也会同意，这对Najjar先生和Sirius先生这种劳动密集型工作来说是必需的。

source: Moreso, it’s entirely unreasonable to demand any person to commit themselves to business outside of work hours. That’s just straight up unethical.
translation: 更何况，要求任何人在工作时间之外全身心投入工作，完全不合理。那根本不符合道德。

source: Regardless of our schedules and routines, we all adjusted to each other and finished the work according to all the deadlines.
translation: 不管我们的日程和安排如何，我们都互相适应了，并按照所有截止日期完成了工作。

source: Yeah! No one snooped around and called you out for your personal time!
translation: 是啊！没人窥探你的私人时间，也没人因此指责你！

source: *whispers* Yuri, calm down.
translation: *小声说* Yuri，冷静点。

source: And you, Mr. Flynn! You continue to exhibit indecent and explicit behavior around the camp despite my previous warnings!
translation: 还有你，Flynn先生！尽管我之前警告过，你仍然在营地里做出不雅、露骨的行为！

source: This leads to distractions that only causes more time lost on the project!
translation: 这会导致分心，只会让项目损失更多时间！

source: How exactly do you think that has any serious effect on our productivity?
translation: 你到底觉得这会对我们的生产力造成什么严重影响？

source: And even so, the people working on this project aren’t machines – you can’t prohibit them from expressing themselves.
translation: 再说，为这个项目工作的人不是机器——你不能禁止他们表达自我。

source: And last but not least, Mr. Nagira.
translation: 最后但同样重要的是，Nagira先生。

source: You and Mr. Nomoru completely disregarded the plan I had laid out, repeatedly performing tasks out of your scope like headless chickens.
translation: 你和Nomoru先生完全无视了我制定的计划，像没头苍蝇一样反复执行超出职责范围的任务。

source: You refused to follow the schedule I made to maximize efficiency only to blindly obey the whims of the camp president!
translation: 你不肯遵守我为提高效率制定的日程，却盲目听从营地负责人的一时兴起！

source: You refused to follow the schedule I made to maximize efficiency only to blindly obey the whims of the camp president!{fast}
translation: 你不肯遵守我为提高效率制定的日程，却盲目听从营地负责人的一时兴起！{fast}

source: You're not the boss of me.
translation: 你又不是我的老板。

source: I’m sorry, but you’re not in charge here, Sir Goro is.
translation: 抱歉，但这里不是你负责，Goro先生才是。

source: That's not the case.
translation: 事实不是这样。

source: Th-That’s not what happened, Emilia!
translation: 这、这不是那样，Emilia！

source: It’s only natural that unexpected things happen during a project, and Sir Goro and I dealt with them as they came up.
translation: 项目中出现意外情况很正常，Goro先生和我都是在问题出现时及时处理的。

source: You're the one causing delays.
translation: 是你在造成延误。

source: I’m sorry, but if anyone has been causing delays here, it’s you.
translation: 抱歉，但如果说这里有人造成了延误，那就是你。

source: Sir Goro knows what's best.
translation: Goro先生知道什么才是最好的。

source: Sir Goro knows what’s best for the project, not you.
translation: Goro先生知道什么对项目最好，不是你。

source: I trust his judgment when it comes to Camp Buddy, and I believe we worked as best as we could.
translation: 关于 Camp Buddy，我信任他的判断，我相信我们已经尽了最大努力。

source: That doesn’t change the fact that you two have purposefully kept me out of the loop, all because you’re incapable of taking action without someone telling you what to do!
translation: 这并不能改变你们两个故意把我排除在外的事实，因为你们没有别人告诉就不知道该采取行动！

source: You can keep ignoring every statement I make, Ms. Komarova, but I will not tolerate this any longer!
translation: 你可以继续无视我说的每一句话，Komarova女士，但我不会再容忍下去了！

source: These so-called ‘issues’ you’ve brought forward during this meeting have been completely irrelevant to the project, and quite frankly not worth Mr. Clermont’s, or any of our time.
translation: 你在这次会议上提出的这些所谓“问题”与项目完全无关，坦白说，不值得Clermont先生，也不值得我们任何人浪费时间。

source: What? How dare y—
translation: 什么？你怎么敢——

source: I’m not done talking.
translation: 我还没说完。

source: Every single claim you’ve made, I’ve disproven with facts and rationally explained how ridiculous your arguments were.
translation: 你提出的每一项指控，我都用事实驳倒了，也理性地解释了你的论点有多荒谬。

source: If anything, all of these are personal issues which are a direct result of you refusing to get along with your fellow co-workers.
translation: 真要说的话，这些都是个人问题，直接源于你拒绝和同事好好相处。

source: Personal?! I’m the only one who’s been professional here!
translation: 个人问题？！这里唯一专业的人是我！

source: Shouldn’t you know better than anyone as the camp’s leader that business is no place for emotional attachment?!
translation: 作为营地领导者，你难道不应该比任何人都清楚，工作场合不该掺杂情感联系吗？！

source: No. A good leader treats everyone with sincerity and respect, especially those who make the project possible.
translation: 不。优秀的领导者会真诚、尊重地对待所有人，尤其是那些让项目得以进行的人。

source: I have a great deal of experience leading groups of people even before Camp Buddy, so don’t tell me how to do my job.
translation: 就算在 Camp Buddy 之前，我也有丰富的团队领导经验，所以别来教我怎么工作。

source: And how dare you call yourself a professional when all you’ve done is critique and never once lifted a finger to join in on the labor?
translation: 你又有什么资格自称专业人士？你做的只有批评，从来没有真正参与劳动，甚至没动过一根手指！

source: So tell me, Ms. Komarova. What ‘credentials’ give you the right to tell me how to run my own camp?
translation: 那么告诉我，Komarova女士。什么“资历”让你有权告诉我该如何管理自己的营地？

source: I… Well—
translation: 我……这个——

source: Well, Mr. Nomoru? It's your call.
translation: 那么，Nomoru先生？由你决定。

source: I think we can all agree that this is just a simple misunderstanding that’s been blown out of proportion.
translation: 我想大家都同意，这只是一个被夸大的简单误会。

source: Yes, I’m sure it seems quite jarring coming off of the events here today, but I honestly wasn’t expecting such a back and forth.
translation: 是的，考虑到今天这里发生的一切，我相信这确实显得很突然，但我没想到会变成这样来回争执。

source: However, it was a part of today’s agenda.
translation: 不过，这本来就是今天议程的一部分。

source: To celebrate the completion of our initial objective, I thought it would be fitting to set up a celebratory trip! I’ve booked an exclusive hotel for everyone to stay at this weekend!
translation: 为了庆祝我们完成最初目标，我觉得安排一次庆祝旅行很合适！我已经订好了一家专属酒店，大家这个周末可以住在那里！

source: I just want to know why you’ve been acting this way for months now…!
translation: 我只想知道，你这几个月为什么一直这样做……！

source: Seriously?! After you kept your mouth shut and let everyone gang up on me back there, you still have the nerve to attack me like this?!
translation: 你认真的吗？！刚才你闭口不言，任由所有人围攻我，现在居然还有脸这样攻击我？！

source: Everyone kept cowering behind that sorry excuse for a leader who just keeps abusing his power!
translation: 每个人都躲在那个只会滥用权力的可悲领导者身后瑟瑟发抖！

source: That’s not true, Emilia! Sir Goro was only trying to defend everyone from your criticisms!
translation: 这不是真的，Emilia！Goro先生只是想保护大家不受你的批评！

source: Everything he said had a point, and he even acknowledged all your efforts in the end!
translation: 他说的每一句都有道理，最后还承认了你付出的所有努力！

source: Go ahead, keep licking his boots! That’s all you’ve ever done!
translation: 你继续舔他的靴子吧！你一直以来就只会这个！

source: Hmm… I’m not surprised she said all that.
translation: 嗯……她说这些我一点也不意外。

source: I think I may have upset her even more than when we were with Mr. Clermont.
translation: 我觉得自己可能比我们和Clermont先生在一起时更让她恼火了。

source: Don’t blame yourself for it, Yoshinori. Emilia’s actions are her own.
translation: 别把责任归咎于自己，Yoshinori。Emilia的行为由她自己负责。

source: But still… Maybe if I had stood up in the meeting, things wouldn’t have escalated like that.
translation: 但还是……如果我在会议上站出来，也许事情就不会升级成那样。

source: *sigh* Now that I take responsibility for.
translation: *叹气* 现在我得为此负责。

source: With how Emilia has been acting, I knew something was bound to happen.
translation: 以Emilia一直以来的表现，我知道迟早会发生什么。

source: Unfortunately, Mr. Clermont had to see it, which was quite embarrassing.
translation: 不幸的是，Clermont先生亲眼看到了，实在很丢脸。

source: And I’ll be honest, I already regret losing my temper back there. I said some pretty hurtful things.
translation: 老实说，我已经后悔刚才失去理智了。我说了一些相当伤人的话。

source: And I’ll be honest, I already regret losing my temper back there. I said some pretty hurtful things.{fast}
translation: 老实说，我已经后悔刚才失去理智了。我说了一些相当伤人的话。{fast}

source: She needs to learn a lesson.
translation: 她需要吸取教训。

source: It’s about time someone said those things to her. She needs to learn a lesson.
translation: 早就该有人对她说这些了。她需要吸取教训。

source: I don’t disagree, but what bothered me the most is how she kept digging into everyone, especially you…
translation: 我不否认，但最让我在意的是她一直揪着所有人不放，尤其是你……

source: She deserved it.
translation: 她活该。

source: It’s about time someone said those things to her. She deserved it.
translation: 早就该有人对她说这些了。她活该。

source: I would've done the same.
translation: 我也会这么做。

source: But I honestly would’ve done the same, sir…
translation: 不过，说实话我也会这么做，先生……

source: I just couldn’t let her keep berating everyone, especially you, Yoshinori…
translation: 我只是不能让她继续辱骂大家，尤其是你，Yoshinori……

source: You were only trying to protect us.
translation: 你只是想保护我们。

source: But you were only trying to protect all of us, sir…
translation: 但你只是想保护我们所有人，先生……

source: I don’t care what her opinion of me is, but knowing how hard you’ve worked, I wasn’t going to stand by while she disrespected you like that.
translation: 我不在乎她怎么看我，但知道你付出了这么多，我不会眼睁睁看着她那样不尊重你。

source: Still, I regret stooping down to her level and fighting with her about everything.
translation: 不过，我后悔把自己降到她的水平，和她争论一切。

source: If Mr. Clermont hadn’t stepped in, I wouldn’t have realized how uncomfortable you and everyone else were.
translation: 如果不是Clermont先生出面，我不会意识到你和其他人有多不舒服。

source: That’s when I knew I had to steer things in a different direction.
translation: 那时我知道，必须把事情引向不同的方向。

source: Is that why you let Emilia stay…?
translation: 是因为这个你才让Emilia留下吗……？

source: Partly... I know most of you spent time with Emilia back when she was a scout. I stopped and thought of what you would’ve done in that scenario…
translation: 部分原因……我知道你们大多数人在Emilia还是童子军时都和她相处过。我停下来想了想，如果是你，你会怎么做……

source: Emilia was only trying to prove a point from her perspective, and she must have reasons for the way she’s been acting.
translation: 从她的角度看，Emilia只是想证明自己的观点，她这样做一定有自己的理由。

source: And if there’s anything I’ve learned from you and the scouts, removing her would only cause resentment when we could still resolve things together.
translation: 而我从你和童子军们身上学到了一件事：既然我们还能一起解决问题，把她赶走只会带来怨恨。

source: Maybe this wouldn’t have happened if I’d just worked with Emilia from the start…
translation: 如果我一开始就和Emilia一起工作，也许这就不会发生了……

source: Don’t say that, Yoshinori. I’m very grateful for the last few months we’ve worked together. I’d stand by that decision no matter what.
translation: 别这么说，Yoshinori。过去几个月我们一起工作，我非常感激。无论如何我都会坚持那个决定。

source: I just need to ensure that Emilia doesn’t continue to bring out the worst in me.
translation: 我只需要确保Emilia不会继续引出我最糟糕的一面。

source: Maybe this getaway Mr. Clermont offered us is the perfect way to get rid of the tension and loosen up some.
translation: 也许Clermont先生提供的这次出行，正好能消除紧张，让我们放松一下。

source: Exactly. I’m actually looking forward to what this vacation has in store for us.
translation: 正是。我其实很期待这次假期会给我们带来什么。

source: Th-Thanks for carrying mine though, Aiden…
translation: 谢谢你帮我拿行李，Aiden……

source: Oof… Trust us, we know…
translation: 哎哟……相信我们，我们懂……

source: Is there even a chance of her getting along with us like Mr. Clermont asked?
translation: 她有没有可能像Clermont先生要求的那样和我们相处？

source: Now calm down, dear. This trip gives us a good chance to unwind after all the stress from work.
translation: 现在冷静点，亲爱的。这次旅行给了我们一个机会，在工作带来的所有压力之后放松一下。

source: Honestly though, I thought she’d be a lot less aggressive in front of Mr. Clermont, but she didn’t even think twice about calling each of us out like that…
translation: 不过说实话，我以为她在Clermont先生面前会收敛很多，没想到她甚至不假思索地把我们每个人都指责了一遍……

source: I’m just relieved you said something back there, Gramps.
translation: 我只是庆幸你刚才说了那些话，Gramps。

source: Oh yeah! That was so satisfying! In my head I was like “Yesss! Yesss! Get her, Dad!”
translation: 对啊！太爽了！我当时心里一直在喊“对对对！爸爸上！教训她！”

source: Sir Goro really saved our butts!
translation: Goro先生真的救了我们！

source: W-Wait… You mean you all weren’t intimidated by me?
translation: 等、等等……你们都没有被我吓到吗？

source: No way! I’m glad you put Emilia in her place!
translation: 才不会！我很高兴你让Emilia安分下来了！

source: We appreciate it.
translation: 我们很感激。

source: You only really said what we were all thinking, sir…
translation: 你只是说出了我们所有人的心里话，先生……

source: But still, I’d rather you all hadn’t seen that.
translation: 但话说回来，我还是希望你们没有看到那一幕。

source: I guess that was first time you’ve raised your voice like that around us, sir.
translation: 我想那是你第一次在我们面前这样提高音量，先生。

source: Yeah. He never got angry, even when we were scouts.
translation: 是啊。就算我们还是童子军时，你也从来没有生气过。

source: Haha, you guys should’ve seen him over the last few years, then! He was the stiffest and scariest guy you’d ever met!
translation: 哈哈，那你们应该看看过去几年里的他！他可是你们见过的最死板、最可怕的人！

source: *sigh* Did you really have to bring that up, Aiden?
translation: *叹气* Aiden，你真的非得提起这个吗？

source: It’s so hard for me to imagine Sir Goro being strict... He's been cuddly and gentle with me ever since I first met him.
translation: 我很难想象Goro先生会这么严厉……自从第一次见到他，他一直都很温柔、喜欢抱我。

source: But now I get it after seeing it up close and personal… I-It was kinda hot…
translation: 但现在亲眼近距离看到后我明白了……这、这有点性感……

source: You guys should know that someone like Emilia won’t get away with causing trouble with Dad keeping his eye on her!
translation: 你们要知道，有爸爸盯着，Emilia这种人不可能惹事后全身而退！

source: She’s lucky Dad’s way past his gangster days, or else she would’ve been taken down!
translation: 她应该庆幸爸爸早就过了黑帮时代，不然她早就被收拾了！

source: I’m sorry, what…?
translation: 抱歉，你说什么……？

source: Yuri! I told you never to bring that up!
translation: Yuri！我告诉过你永远别提那个！

source: Wait! Don’t tell me you were a hitman or something back before Camp Buddy, Gramps?!
translation: 等等！别告诉我在 Camp Buddy 之前，Gramps你是杀手之类的？！

source: Okay, now that’s actually scary.
translation: 好吧，这确实有点吓人。

source: Thug life.
translation: 痞子人生。

source: *ehem* Don’t get carried away, all of you. I just happened to be mixed in with the wrong crowd during my younger years.
translation: *呃咳* 别让想象跑太远，大家。我年轻时只是碰巧混进了错误的人群。

source: By wrong crowd, he means a biker gang~!
translation: 所谓错误的人群，就是摩托车帮派~！

source: A-A biker gang?!
translation: 一、一群摩托车帮派？！

source: I-It was more of a fraternity… it’s not as bad as you’re all imagining.
translation: 这、这更像是兄弟会……没你们想象的那么糟。

source: H-How have we never heard of any of this?
translation: 我们怎么从没听说过这些？

source: Well, it’s far in the past, way before Camp Buddy was around.
translation: 那都是很久以前的事了，早在 Camp Buddy 还不存在的时候。

source: There was never a reason to bring it up… And I don’t think it’s something to be proud of either…
translation: 根本没理由提起……而且我也不觉得这是值得骄傲的事……

source: That explains all the leather…
translation: 这就解释了那些皮革……

source: I know, right? But don’t let him downplay it – he was actually their leader, too!
translation: 我知道，对吧？不过别让他轻描淡写——他其实还是他们的领袖！

source: Ooooohhh! So, that’s what he meant back at the meeting!
translation: 哦哦哦！所以这就是他在会议上说的意思！

source: Gramps was the number one tough guy in a group of tough guys! That’s crazy!
translation: Gramps可是硬汉中的第一硬汉！太疯狂了！

source: Top dog.
translation: 顶头老大。

source: This is all so much to take in…
translation: 这些信息一下子太多了……

source: I don’t talk about it for a reason. I can’t imagine the scouts would appreciate knowing their leader was once not a good example.
translation: 我不谈它是有原因的。我无法想象童子军们知道他们的领袖曾经不是一个好榜样后，会怎么想。

source: And like I said, I have long put that behind me.
translation: 而且就像我说的，我早已把那段过去抛在身后。

source: You shouldn’t be ashamed of it, Dad! All of us think it’s cool! Right, guys?
translation: 你不该为此感到羞愧，爸爸！我们都觉得很酷！对吧，大家？

source: *sigh* Why are you insistent on this, Yuri-dear? You weren’t even born then.
translation: *叹气* Yuri亲爱的，你为什么非要纠结这个？那时你甚至还没出生。

source: Exactly! You barely tell me anything about it! We all deserve to know!
translation: 正是！你几乎从没告诉我任何关于那段过去的事！我们都有权知道！

source: Oh, come on, Dad!
translation: 哎呀，爸爸！

source: Hahaha, let it go, Yuri! Gramps’ face is already red!
translation: 哈哈哈，算了吧，Yuri！Gramps的脸已经红了！

source: Welp! If that’s all we’re getting, then I guess I’ll go ahead and do my night routines – we’ve spent enough time chit-chatting!
translation: 好吧！既然只能听到这些，那我就去做我的夜间例行工作了——我们闲聊的时间够多了！

source: Oh, right. I have to finish packing too.
translation: 哦，对了。我还得收拾行李。

source: Let me help.
translation: 让我帮你。

source: Heeeey! Don’t change the subject!
translation: 嘿——别转移话题！

source: Yuri, to your room. NOW.
translation: Yuri，回你的房间。现在。

source: Eek! Yes, Dad!
translation: 咿！好的，爸爸！

source: Hahaha! Can’t believe that worked, Gramps!
translation: 哈哈哈！真不敢相信这招对Gramps有用！

source: Daddy mode on.
translation: 爸爸模式开启。

source: I think I have a new kink…
translation: 我好像发现了一个新癖好……

source: There we go! I think I’m fully packed!
translation: 好了！我想我已经全部收拾好了！

source: Do you need any help checking your bags, Sir Goro?
translation: 需要我帮你检查行李吗，Goro先生？

source: No need – Yuri already handled it. She's so excited she couldn't even wait to start loading up all our stuff.
translation: 不用——Yuri已经处理好了。她太兴奋，甚至等不及就开始把我们的东西都装上车。

source: Although I don’t blame her… I’m just as ready for a vacation where I don’t have to worry about any responsibilities.
translation: 不过我也不怪她……我同样已经迫不及待想要来一场不用操心任何责任的假期。

source: Me too, sir. It'll be fun even if it's just for a few days, especially after how busy we've been!
translation: 我也是，先生。哪怕只有几天也会很有趣，尤其是考虑到我们最近一直忙个不停！

source: I know we’ve been able to spend a great deal of time together working, but this is the perfect opportunity for us both to focus on enjoying each other’s company.
translation: 我知道我们一起工作时已经相处了很长时间，但这次是我们专心享受彼此陪伴的绝佳机会。

source: Just pure quality time with each other.
translation: 只是纯粹的高质量二人时光。

source: Wait… Do you hear that?
translation: 等等……你听到了吗？

source: Jin? You’re not trying to work before the vacation, are you?
translation: Jin？你不会打算在放假前还工作吧？

source: A-And no, I’m not working either!
translation: 而、而且我也没有工作！

source: Ah… It sounds like you two have been having a secret affair, huh?
translation: 啊……听起来你们两个一直有秘密恋情，嗯？

source: *cough* I wish.
translation: *咳嗽* 我倒希望是。

source: Ah, right! I didn’t get to tell you that Jin and I were working on this little website project, sir!
translation: 啊，对了！我还没告诉你，Jin和我正在做一个小网站项目，先生！

source: Oh? What’s it about?
translation: 哦？是关于什么的？

source: We’re transcribing Yuri’s journal and restoring the photos for a blog! Jin’s doing most of the work though, since I’m notoriously bad with anything tech-related…
translation: 我们在整理Yuri的日记，并为博客修复照片！不过大部分工作由Jin完成，因为我在所有技术相关的事情上都出了名地不擅长……

source: That sounds interesting.
translation: 听起来很有意思。

source: Oh, if you’re not too tired, Sir Goro, why don’t we help Jin finish up tonight?
translation: 哦，如果你不太累，Goro先生，不如今晚我们帮Jin收尾？

source: I don’t mind. The more hands, the better, right?
translation: 我不介意。人手越多越好，对吧？

source: One… two… three…
Hngh! It didn’t budge!
translation: 嗯啊！它纹丝不动！

source: Oh man… How can I make a campfire if I can’t even split wood?
translation: 哎呀……如果连劈木头都做不到，我怎么生营火？

source: I dunno, Yoshi… Shouldn’t you be doing something else for today’s badge activity?
translation: 我不知道，Yoshi……今天的徽章活动你不应该做点别的吗？

source: I mean… This looks really dangerous. You’ve missed and sent that axe flying about three times now.
translation: 我的意思是……这看起来真的很危险。你已经失手三次左右，把斧头都甩出去了。

source: You’ll lose both of your legs before you get a badge.
translation: 你在拿到徽章之前，双腿就要先没了。

source: Well, it’s not just for the badge! I saw Sir Goro chopping trees over there, and I thought I could help!
translation: 这不只是为了徽章！我看到Goro先生在那边砍树，就想帮忙！

source: Also, I thought it was super cool! His really huge muscles can take down trees like they’re nothing!
translation: 而且我觉得超级酷！他那特别巨大的肌肉砍倒树就像玩一样！

source: Oh… So that’s what this is about.
translation: 哦……原来是这么回事。

source: Huh?
translation: 嗯？

source: You’ve got a crush on the camp president.
translation: 你喜欢上营地负责人了。

source: Ah, there you boys, are! I’ve been looking for—
translation: 啊，你们在那边啊！我一直在找——

source: Yoshinori! Where did you get this axe from?!
translation: Yoshinori！你从哪里拿到这把斧头的？！

source: Umm... the shed???
translation: 呃……储藏室？？？

source: Uh-oh…
translation: 糟糕……

source: *sigh* You’re trying to split wood, are you?
translation: *叹气* 你想劈木头，是吗？

source: Look, I know you want to help around the camp, Yoshinori. But this is not a job for a scout.
translation: 听着，我知道你想为营地出力，Yoshinori。但这不是童子军该做的工作。

source: Also, shouldn’t you all be with the other scouts for the badge activity?
translation: 再说，你们不是应该和其他童子军一起参加徽章活动吗？

source: I’m sorry, sir. I also thought a woodcutting badge would be cool…
translation: 对不起，先生。我也觉得伐木徽章听起来很酷……

source: Well, you’re not holding the axe the right way. Here, let me show you.
translation: 你拿斧头的方式不对。来，我示范给你看。

source: You need to have a stable base, preferably a stump, larger than the rounds you’re going to be splitting on top of it.
translation: 你需要一个稳定的底座，最好是树桩，比你要劈开的木段更大，让木段放在上面。

source: Not only will that give you a good, flat surface to work with, but your axe will also have a place to dig into.
translation: 这样不仅能提供一个平整的工作表面，斧头也有地方可以劈进去。

source: You’re going to break your blade if you keep splitting wood directly on the ground.
translation: 如果你一直直接在地面上劈木头，刀刃会坏掉的。

source: Clear a spot around you… Spread your legs… Hold your axe like this…
translation: 清理你周围的地方……分开双腿……像这样握住斧头……

source: Raise your arms overhead, extending them high with a straight body…
translation: 将双臂举过头顶，身体保持笔直，向上伸展……

source: …then SWING!
translation: ……然后挥下去！

source: Whoaaa!
Holy wood boulevard!
translation: 神圣的木材大道！

source: *claps*
translation: *鼓掌*

source: That was so freaking awesome, Sir Goro!
translation: 太他妈厉害了，Goro先生！

source: Well, want me to teach you?
translation: 那么，想让我教你吗？

source: Do I ever!!
translation: 当然想！！

source: Come here then.
translation: 那就过来。

source: First, plan where you’re going to aim by looking for cracks so you can align yourself with them as your target.
translation: 首先，寻找裂缝来规划你要瞄准的位置，让自己对准裂缝作为目标。

source: Avoid knots and twisted grains – instead aim your blow near the edge of the round but not at the very center.
translation: 避开树节和扭曲的纹理——瞄准木段边缘附近，但不要正中心。

source: Ohhh… So that’s why no matter how hard I was hitting it, it wouldn’t split.
translation: 哦哦……所以不管我砍得多用力，它都不会裂开，是因为这个。

source: Splitting wood is not just about strength, you need good technique and posture too.
translation: 劈木头不只是力量问题，你还需要好的技巧和姿势。

source: You should stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, so that you won’t hit your leg after a swing.
translation: 双脚应该分开与肩同宽，这样挥下斧头后就不会砍到腿。

source: Then hold your axe near your waist – one hand on the base of the handle, palm facing toward you and the other hand at the neck, palm facing away, thumb next to the axe head.
translation: 然后把斧头握在腰部附近——一只手放在斧柄底部，手掌朝向自己；另一只手放在斧颈处，手掌朝外，拇指贴近斧头。

source: During your upswing, extend your body like I showed you earlier, raising your toes up a little, while sliding your other hand down to the handle to gain momentum.
translation: 向上挥斧时，像我之前示范的那样伸展身体，脚趾稍微踮起，同时把另一只手沿斧柄向下滑，以获得冲力。

source: When you deliver a forceful downswing, concentrate your vision on your target, all the way down to the base.
translation: 用力向下挥砍时，把视线集中在目标上，一直看到斧头劈到底部。

source: Bend into a squat, adding the weight of your body to the force of impact.
translation: 蹲下，把身体的重量加到冲击力中。

source: Yo-shi-no-ri cutting down a tree.
translation: 吉——野——里——砍倒了一棵树。

source: Face-as-red-as a strawberry.
translation: 脸红得像草莓。

source: C-Cut it out, you guys…!
translation: 这、这就够了，你们……！

source: Now… Give it a try.
translation: 现在……试试看。

source: Whew... Okay…
translation: 呼……好吧……

source: On my count. One… Two…
translation: 听我的口令。一……二……

source: SWING!
translation: 挥下去！

source: WAH! I did it!
translation: 哇！我做到了！

source: See? It’s pretty easy.
translation: 看吧？其实很简单。

source: Wow, I wanna try too!
translation: 哇，我也想试试！

source: Do you want me to hug you also?
translation: 你要不要我也抱着你？

source: Does this mean you’ll let me split wood now too, Sir Goro?!
translation: 这是不是意味着我现在也可以劈木头了，Goro先生？！

source: Sure, but only when I’m supervising.
translation: 可以，但只有我监督的时候。

source: YES! YES! Thank you! Thank you!
translation: 是的！是的！谢谢！谢谢！

source: Six in the morning sharp, you'll come with me, and we'll chop wood together.
translation: 早上六点准时，你跟我一起去，我们一起砍木头。

source: Heh, it doesn’t look like he struggled tonight.
translation: 呵，他今晚看起来没怎么挣扎。

source: Haha, you’re acting like a scoutmaster even now, Yoshinori.
translation: 哈哈，你现在就像个童子军团长，Yoshinori。

source: A-Ah, am I? I guess Jin could be a camper…
translation: 啊、啊，是吗？我想Jin可以当个营员……

source: True. But regardless, we should get some rest too.
translation: 没错。不过不管怎样，我们也该休息了。

source: We have a long day of travel ahead of us tomorrow!
translation: 我们明天要赶很长的一段路！

source: Right! Goodnight, sir!
translation: 好的！晚安，先生！

source: Goodnight, Yoshinori.
translation: 晚安，Yoshinori。
